mutants.invariant: Successful purchased quantity never exceeds initial stock and stock never becomes negative
mutants.oracle: Twenty concurrent orders against stock five

mutants.invariant: Same user, key and body create exactly one order and charge
A buyer can read only their own orders
mutants.oracle: Buyer B requests Buyer A order

mutants.invariant: Invalid webhook HMAC causes no state change
One webhook event ID changes payment state at most once
Order quantity must be positive and invalid input cannot change stock
mutants.oracle: Submit quantity zero and negative two

mutants.invariant: Failed payment leaves no confirmed order, charge or lost inventory
One logical checkout produces at most one provider charge
An order transitions to cancelled once and restores stock once
mutants.oracle: Cancel the same paid order twice concurrently

mutants.invariant: Order total equals catalog price multiplied by accepted quantity
